premises.text: Text input efficiency has declined in recent years despite advances in computing power
premises.evidence_span: Except lately, something has not. Can you think of what has not obeyed Moore's Law? It's actually gone down the last couple years, significantly.

premises.text: Existing text input methods on tablets are inefficient for long typing tasks
premises.evidence_span: If you've tried typing something long on a tablet, like an email, you've probably had this experience.

premises.text: Innovations for people with disabilities can be adapted for general tablet users
premises.evidence_span: a lot of things we did for people with disabilities can be applied.

premises.text: Drift allows users to type naturally on tablet screens by moving the keyboard under their fingers
premises.evidence_span: we move the keys to their fingers.

premises.text: Drift uses both touch and accelerometer sensors to detect typing
premises.evidence_span: we combine two sensors, touch and tap.

premises.text: Drift can significantly improve typing speed on tablets compared to existing solutions
premises.evidence_span: we're estimating today we're about 2x the performance of today's tablet solutions.

premises.text: The tablet market is growing and presents an opportunity for Drift
premises.evidence_span: we all know tablets are exploding in the consumer market.

value.text: Drift enhances typing efficiency and user experience on tablets
value.evidence_span: how Drift can impact the lives of everybody for any type of enterprise application in the field and in the school.
